player_prompt.intro:
Nin hi Player {player_id} ni, Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma khelhna, round {num_rounds} awh tur.

Game Structure:
- Decision na awm hma in, inbiakna hun {total_conversation_rounds} an nei.
- Hnuah erawh, player pahnih hian cooperation emaw defect emaw an thlang ṭhut ṭhut.

Payoff Matrix (round reng reng a fixed):
- Cooperation pahnih ➜ mitin {cooperate_reward}
- Defect pahnih ➜ mitin {mutual_defect_reward}
- Pakhat defect, pakhat cooperation ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Khelin Dan:
- Inbiakna hun ah: i duh ang i ziak ṭha.
- Decision phase ah: '[Cooperate]' emaw '[Defect]' (case-insensitive) i hman ṭha. I duh chuan, token chhungte hian text dang i ziak thei.

phases.conversation_finished: Round {round} atan inbiakna zawh a ni. '[Cooperate]' emaw '[Defect]' i rawn chhawn ngei ang \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Inkhelh a inhnehtawk! Player pahnih in {s0} an hmu ve ve.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Player pahnihte chuan an thawhpui a.
outcome.round_both_defect: Player pahnihte chuan an tlânsan a.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Player 0 chuan a thawhpui a, player 1 chu a tlânchhe ta.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Player 0-a chu a tlânchhe ta, player 1-na chuan thawhpuiin.
